messages.subject: Project Redwood – Report on Title
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Daniel,

Our Report on Title for Kingsgate House is attached. Headline: the freehold title (NGL482190) is good and marketable and may safely be acquired at £18,500,000. There is one charge in favour of Northbank Plc which will be discharged on completion. The Property is sold subject to six occupational leases producing £1,362,200 p.a.; two leases contain tenant break options (2028 and 2029) which we've flagged for asset management. SDLT will be £914,500.

We're content to proceed to exchange subject to clear pre-completion searches and your board approval. Happy to talk it through.
